commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 14 and benchmark indices facing institutional distribution via persistent foreign capital outflows, classical O'Neil and Weinstein principles mandate extreme capital defense. In an unconfirmed market direction, breakouts have elevated failure rates, forcing strict progressive exposure. Legendary discipline dictates that no technical setup—regardless of volume expansion or base symmetry—warrants aggressive positioning unless confirmed by accelerating quarterly earnings (C+A). Among scanned candidates, only select commodity cyclicals demonstrate triple-digit bottom-line thrust, while growth deceleration across wealth, IT, and diversified industrials caps most setups at Watch or Avoid until distribution subsides.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Discipline

ANANDRATHI.technical: Trading firmly above upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Price is consolidating within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot with constructive 2.08x volume expansion and momentum supported by RSI at 67.
ANANDRATHI.fundamental: AUM expansion drove revenue up 16% YoY with strong net profit margins over 30% and zero debt. However, bottom-line growth has decelerated below CANSLIM's 25% threshold, failing full qualification.
ANANDRATHI.risk: Thesis breaks below the 2171.37 swing low; close under SMA50 invalidates the pivot structure.

ANTELOPUS.technical: Formed a clear double-bottom reversal clearing neckline resistance on massive 4.05x average volume. Price holds comfortably above key moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) with unextended RSI at 54.
ANTELOPUS.fundamental: Virtually debt-free upstream producer benefiting from Cambay field assets, generating 19.9% ROCE. However, erratic quarterly net margins and sub-10% recent profit growth fail strict CANSLIM standards.
ANTELOPUS.risk: Fails on a decisive breakdown below 1164.98 stop, violating double-bottom base support.

CHENNPETRO.technical: Emerging from a double-bottom base with price above EMA21, SMA50, and rising SMA200. Strong demand confirmation is visible via 2.04x volume expansion with RSI at 59 showing constructive upside runway.
CHENNPETRO.fundamental: Explosive Q2 profit expansion driven by gross refining margins doubling to $20.41/bbl, expanding EBITDA margins to 15.6%. Revenue growth of 10% falls just short of the 15% CANSLIM benchmark.
CHENNPETRO.risk: Strict stop at 1497.66; thesis invalidates if crack spreads collapse and price cuts below SMA50.

CRISIL.technical: Well-defined Stage 2 uptrend maintaining alignment above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Tight price action within 1.5% of its pivot on 1.89x volume; RSI at 70 reflects solid relative strength.
CRISIL.fundamental: Dominant rating and analytics franchise with pristine balance sheet, zero debt, and exceptional ROE. Nevertheless, Q3 profit deceleration to 5.9% YoY breaches the 25% earnings acceleration requirement.
CRISIL.risk: Stop loss triggered on violation of 4597.26; exit immediately if pivot rejection triggers distribution.

CYIENT.technical: Darvas-style box breakout to new 52-week highs on staggering 25.29x average volume. Price is extended well above rising moving averages, reflecting powerful institutional accumulation.
CYIENT.fundamental: Topline grew 25% YoY with record order intake, but net profit contracted 5% due to margin pressure and elevated semiconductor R&D spend, failing the CANSLIM 'C' rule.
CYIENT.risk: Breach of 1112.61 trailing stop invalidates breakout box; exit if breakout turns into a bull trap.

DCMSRIND.technical: Attempting a bottoming base breakout from micro-cap levels, crossing EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 on 3.43x volume. Momentum is stretched short-term with RSI at 72 pushing near overbought territory.
DCMSRIND.fundamental: Post-demerger sugar and alcohol business faces acute operational headwinds, with multiple quarters of falling revenues, negative earnings growth, weak sub-10% ROCE, and leveraged operations.
DCMSRIND.risk: Breakdown below 48.88 stop confirms failed base attempt; cut immediately on lower volume support loss.
